term_source.title: National Insurance, שאלות ותשובות – חיסכון לכל ילד

explain_he: חיסכון לכל ילד שההורה בחר לנהל בבנק: הריבית נקבעת ביום הפתיחה לכל התקופה, היתרה לא יורדת מהסכומים שהביטוח הלאומי הפקיד, ומסלול משתנה רק בתחנת יציאה

source.title: National Insurance, שאלות ותשובות – חיסכון לכל ילד

notes: The site's name for the bank route of חיסכון לכל ילד (wrapper child-savings-bank); NII and the law speak of saving 'בבנק' versus 'בקופת גמל להשקעה' (law 74ב). Three tracks per bank, fixed unlinked, prime-variable and CPI-linked, each with or without an exit station every five years; the rate is set on the opening day for 18 minus the child's age (CS-10, Yahav agreement). Nine banks, the 2016 tender winners (CS-22). Bank money cannot move to another bank; since January 2025 a parent may once redirect future deposits to a provident fund while the balance stays in the bank (CS-12). NII pays the bank's operating costs until 21 (CS-25). Tax on the gains is an open question (TXK-20). Added 2026-10-23 for the guide card lede.

source.title: חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל), התשס"ה-2005 (Nevo mirror)

notes: The site's name for the study-fund kind of קופת גמל בניהול אישי (wrapper ira-hishtalmut); in law it is a study fund approved for one member who gives the investment instructions (IRA-01, s.1 definition and s.57). Study-fund money enters from the first shekel up to four times 'הסכום הקובע' across all study-fund accounts (IRA-07). Only tradable securities, deposits, structured products, foreign currency and fund units, in Israel or an approved foreign country, with issuer and derivative limits and no borrowing (IRA-11 to IRA-13). The managing company's fee is per the written agreement; brokerage, custody and fund costs come on top from a closed list (IRA-16, IRA-17). Withdrawal and tax follow the study fund's rules (IRA-25, TXK-17); the investment risk is the member's (IRA-26). Gemel-Net 202609 lists it under 'קרנות השתלמות'; Meitav's joining annex is titled 'קרן השתלמות בניהול אישי'. Added 2026-10-23 for the guide card lede.
